integrity: The full-dimensional sharpness formula is proved analytically; a deterministic exact-rational checker is supplemental. Bibliographic originality is limited by possibly unindexed prior literature. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact depth only for three specified slices, centered at a halfspace-depth maximizer, with \(-rK\subseteq K\); does not settle unrestricted higher-dimensional mixed-integer depth or extend past the inclusion threshold.
title: Exact three-slice halfspace depth by reflected-core pairing
